send: su 0 dmesg -n 1
i=0; while [ "$(getprop sys.boot_completed)" != 1 ] && [ $i -lt 900 ]; do sleep 3; i=$((i+3)); done; sleep 25; echo BOOTDONE=$(getprop sys.boot_completed)

g() { set -- $1 $(getprop vendor.openbook.gfx.summary); echo "GFXO $1 mode=$3 phase=$4 writes=$7 result=$9 fw=$(getprop vendor.openbook.gfx.fw) loads=$(su 0 logcat -d -b kernel | grep -c "starting service 'vendor.openbook.dgpu-driver'") hda=$(su 0 logcat -d -b kernel | grep -c "starting service 'vendor.openbook.dgpu-hda'") avc=$(su 0 logcat -d -b kernel | grep 'avc:' | grep denied | grep -c -E 'openbook_gfx_mode|openbook_pc_setup|vendor_init') end"; }
su 0 logcat -d -b kernel | grep -E 'openbook-gfx-mode: boot [0-9]+:|vendor.openbook.dgpu-hda|avc: .*(openbook_gfx_mode|openbook_pc_setup|vendor_init)' | sed 's/^/GFXO_KLOG /'
su 0 setprop ro.vendor.openbook.gfx.fw_writes 1; echo FW=$(su 0 getprop ro.vendor.openbook.gfx.fw_writes)
g boot1

wait: GFXO boot1 mode=hybrid phase=idle writes=off result=- fw=mux=1,dgpu=0 loads=1 hda=1 avc=\d+ end

send: setprop debug.openbook.lab enable; sleep 8; echo LAB-ON

wait: GFXO eco1 mode=eco phase=idle writes=on result=adb:done fw=mux=1,dgpu=1 loads=1 hda=1 avc=\d+ end
